body.tr: Hasta sonuçlarıdır. Zarf, hekiminize kapalı olarak teslim edilmelidir. Sonuçların yorumu hekime aittir.
body.en: Patient results enclosed. This envelope must be delivered to your physician sealed. Interpretation rests with the physician.

en.from: must be delivered to your physician sealed
en.to: They know you will open it.

dialog.speaker: npc:clerk
dialog.en: Results are in the envelope. Your doctor's in on Thursday.

choices.en: Hold it up to the light

ac.tr: Zarfı otobüste açtın. Üç değerin yanında ok vardı; ne demek olduklarını perşembeye kadar bilemedin.
ac.en: You opened it on the bus. Three values had arrows next to them. What the arrows meant would wait until Thursday.

coach.en: The arrows hang there until Thursday.

kapali.tr: Zarf perşembeye kadar mutfak masasında durdu. Hekim açtı, "gayet iyi" dedi.
kapali.en: The envelope sat on the kitchen table until Thursday. The doctor opened it and said, "All good."

coach.en: The envelope waited. So did the results.

isik.tr: Zarfı mutfak lambasına tuttun. Yalnızca laboratuvarın amblemi okunuyordu, tersten.
isik.en: You held it up to the kitchen light. All you could read was the lab's emblem. Backwards.

intent.setup: laboratuvarın kapalı sonuç zarfını hekime götürmeden açıp açmamak
